sourcePolicy: Local working tree, tests, diagnostics, scripts, RefPlan5 and local Git history only; no remote Git.

phaseGate.input: Verified Phase 03 topology, Phase 05 schema/provenance and Phase 06 Canonical IR contracts.
phaseGate.output: Versioned frontend-neutral TargetMachine core contract sufficient for Phase 07 value classes, register constraints and call-boundary liveness.
phaseGate.authorityBoundary: Only architectural/compiler-visible target facts are modeled; runtime physical-register allocation, rename, occupancy, scoreboard, execution, publication, commit and retire authority are excluded.
phaseGate.deterministicFallback: Unknown or mismatched schema major, triple, DataLayout, address space, scalar width or register identity deterministically returns Unsupported/Unknown; no host, LLVM or frontend default is imported.

targetContract.aggregateLayout: Natural alignment capped at 8 bytes; unsupported alignment fails closed.
targetContract.architecturalRegisters: x0..x31, 64-bit scalar integer; x0 fixed zero, x1..x31 allocatable
targetContract.primitiveCallBoundary: JAL link destination and JALR return base are explicit carrier operands; no implicit clobbers are inferred.

prequalificationDiagnostic.cause: Test-only aggregate collection equality and target-digest placeholder assertions.
prequalificationDiagnostic.disposition: Assertions completed with the computed golden digest before implementation commit.

releaseDisposition.defaultEnabledScope: Native TargetMachine identity/provenance and fail-closed Native ingress compatibility; full ABI and 08B features remain unsupported.
releaseDisposition.releaseDisposition: Qualified as the Phase 07 prerequisite; final release authorization remains owned by Phase 27.

nextDependencyGate.gate: Add virtual values, allocation constraints, liveness and pressure using only the verified 08A architectural register contract; final physical allocation remains Phase 20.
